scenarios.context: Two students talk about a test.

speakerA.en: How was the English test, Ali?
Lucky you! I found it difficult, especially the grammar part.
Thanks. I felt a bit under the weather this week, so I couldn't study much.
Yes, much better. I'll go to bed early and hit the sack at nine tonight.

speakerB.en: It was a piece of cake. I finished early.
Don't worry. If you want, I can help you before the next one.
That explains it. Are you better now?
Good idea. Rest is important, and you'll feel better tomorrow.

scenarios.context: A boy talks to a girl at a new school.

speakerA.en: I'm new here, and I don't know anyone. How can I break the ice?
What if they don't want to talk to me?
Thanks. Do you think I could sit with you at lunch today?
Great. You'll feel at home in a week, and then you can help the next new student.

speakerB.en: Just say hello and ask a simple question. Most people are friendly.
They will. Once in a blue moon you'll meet someone unfriendly, but that's very rare.
Of course! We always sit by the window.
I hope so. Thank you for being so welcoming.

scenarios.context: Two friends plan a surprise for their teacher.

speakerA.en: Don't spill the beans about the party, okay? It's a secret.
On Friday after school. Everyone is on the same page, so please don't change the plan.
Leila is. I heard it will cost an arm and a leg, so we all have to pay a little.
Definitely. Speak of the devil, here she comes! Let's change the subject.

speakerB.en: I won't say a word. When is it?
Understood. Who is going to buy the cake?
That's fine. Do you think the teacher will be surprised?
Quick, ask me about the football match.

scenarios.context: A girl thinks her friend is joking.

speakerA.en: Guess what? I'm going to meet a famous singer tomorrow.
No, I'm serious. My uncle works for her, and he invited me to the concert.
I'll ask him. Better late than never, so call me tonight.
Thanks. If he agrees, you can meet her with me.

speakerB.en: Are you pulling my leg?
Wow! That's amazing. Can I come too?
I will. I'll keep my fingers crossed that he says yes.
I can't wait. I won't sleep tonight.

scenarios.context: A boy asks a neighbour to take care of his cat.

speakerA.en: Mrs Sadeghi, could you keep an eye on my cat while we're on holiday?
Just ten days. It's a bit hard because she's very shy, and she doesn't like strangers.
Thank you so much. I've been feeling a little down about leaving her.
You've made my day. I'll bring you a present from the trip.

speakerB.en: Of course. How long will you be away?
Don't worry. I love cats, and she will soon get used to me.
Hang in there. She'll be fine, and she'll be happy to see you when you're back.
That's not necessary, but I'd love to hear about it.
